 Al-Qadsiah ‘to appoint’ foreign referees for top-two clash with Al-Hilal 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Al-Qadsiah have moved to secure foreign officials for Friday's top-of-the-table Roshn League meeting with Al-Hilal.
 They host Al-Hilal at Prince Mohammed bin Fahd Stadium in Dammam in the 11th round, and Arriyadiyah reports that a request for a foreign refereeing crew has been submitted.
 OneFootball Videos
 The club also paid the required fee within the legal window, at least 16 days before kick-off.
 This is part of a wider plan, with Al-Qadsiah setting aside a dedicated budget to bring in foreign referees for the season's highest-profile fixtures, this Al-Hilal clash foremost.
 The match brings together the league's top two. Al-Qadsiah lead on 25 points, one ahead of Al-Hilal, who have played a game fewer.
 Source: Goal.com
